messages:
sara: Proposal 1.5h copy sprint Thurs to finalize Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy + webinar landing + inbound routing. Deliverables: 2 hero variants per mode, one launch post (benchmark-led), and HubSpot routing draft.

leo: yep. recommend we keep hero concise: headline + 2 supporting bullets + CTA. PLG tone for Hosted, economics for Dedicated, controls for Private.

anya: i'll bring a one-pager benchmark (latency distribution, batching impact on cost) and 2 customer quotes showing production wins.

matt: i'll draft the form fields: Use case, Team size, Compliance checkbox, Expected RPS. routing rules: team_size>50 OR compliance=true -> enterprise-sales; use_case==evaluation -> webinar nurture; else demo queue. add utm_source=launch, utm_campaign=tri_mode_site.

julia: timeboxes: 20m hero, 35m body/proofs, 25m webinar landing, 20m routing + tracking, 10m next steps.

sara: schedule 10:00-11:30 PT. pre-read due Wed 5pm PT.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach pre-read 24h before meeting. template: ./copy/briefs/site-copy-sprint.md

leo: rough hero drafts:
- Hosted: "Start in minutes 1x dev velocity, zero infra"
- Dedicated: "Reserved capacity, SLA-backed throughput"
- Private: "Run inference on your network 100% data control"

anya: tweak Hosted to be clearer: "Get started in minutes 1 production-grade inference". Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, optimized unit cost".

matt: HubSpot note: include hidden fields for utm_campaign and original_referrer. confirmation page should push event demo_submitted to dataLayer.

sara: webinar plan: 30m talk + 15m Q&A. slides: benchmark, batching cost, routing & fallback, case study. target audience: platform engineers + infra PMs.

leo: launch post angles: 1) benchmark-first (technical channels) 2) customer-first (social). i'll draft both.

anya: will attach benchmark charts and sample copy for bullets.

julia: owners: leo (heroes + launch post drafts), anya (benchmarks + slides), matt (fields & HubSpot workflows), julia (facilitation + notes), sara (final sign-off).

sara: cool. pre-read items due Wed 17:00 PT. aim to publish launch post + webinar invite next Tue. thanks! :tada:
